title: Foot acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration during foot contact as 200 m/s² using a = (v_final - v_initial)/time.

title: Air travel time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the 11m flight as 0.37 s using uniform motion (t = d/v).

title: Goalkeeper acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration magnitude during the block as 175 m/s², accounting for the velocity change.

title: Goalkeeper acceleration direction
description: Important: Correctly identifies the direction of acceleration during the block as opposite to the ball's initial kicked velocity.

title: Correct velocity selection
description: Important: Uses the correct initial and final velocities for each acceleration calculation (0 to 30 m/s for foot, 30 m/s to -5 m/s for goalkeeper).

title: Sign error in rebound
description: Pitfall: Fails to assign a negative sign to the rebound velocity when calculating the goalkeeper's acceleration, leading to an incorrect magnitude.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (m/s², s) for all final answers and maintains unit consistency in calculations.
